note: Owner Ed25519 public verification key. Public material, not a secret. This file is pinned in build_guard.CRITICAL_FILES, so substituting it trips EXECUTABLE_BUILD_LOCK. The owner's private key never enters this repository, this process, or any environment variable; signatures are produced offline by scripts/sign_owner_artifact.py. Until the owner installs a key here every owner act fails closed with OWNER_AUTHORITY_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED, so no amendment can verify and no live authorization can be valid.
